known.title: Not done: Forge's own repo runs a change's related tests once and picks app smoke runs by the changed area.

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done.
Case: normal use - a Forge fix changes design/support.js alongside its mandatory .factory/fixes record.
The selector processes every changed path, and this fallback selects all eight jobs for any unmatched path. Forge commits each item's state when creating its branch (src/forge/task.py:270–283), under .factory/fixes or .factory/stories (src/forge/repo.py:1123–1127). Those records match no area row, so an otherwise design-only or assistant-only change runs every job with full arguments; even a skill.md change runs all jobs. Changed tests and planning files have the same effect. The area tests omit these accompanying files, so they pass while normal pull requests retain the smoke cost this item promises to remove. Exclude known non-smoke files before applying the unknown-template fallback, and cover the accompanying Forge record in the existing selection test.
